integrity: The proof is an exhaustive prefix-closed search with exact integer exponent comparisons, followed by an independent whole-factor recheck of all eight extremizers and an exact symmetry-orbit computation.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the equality cases for the (4, 8/3) row of the finite optimality table. The maximum length 29 is published prior work; the new content is the complete eight-word, two-orbit classification. An unpublished computation or unindexed auxiliary data file could still contain the same equality list.
title: Complete equality classification at the length-\(29\) antisquare threshold obstruction
